email.subject1: a signal play for PTO Exchange
email.body1:
Dan, saw PTO Exchange just crossed three million hours exchanged and launched PTO Early Access.

Launching a new feature like that usually means more in-market HR and benefits buyers than your team can personally touch before the moment cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PTO Exchange off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Dan, quick follow-up for PTO Exchange.

After a launch, demand spikes faster than a sales team can grow, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. That gap tends to surface late, when there is little runway left to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PTO Exchange needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Dan, last bit of proof for PTO Exchange.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PTO Exchange's reply rate likely compares to peers selling into HR. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Dan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while you ride the PTO Early Access momentum, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a launch, and I know that stretch keeps a sales team heads-down.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your benefits motion? I'll tailor it to PTO Exchange either way.
